title: Principal Consultant (Senior Manager) - Finance Transformation
description:

Location: London (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Finance, Risk, Regulatory & Financial Crime | Type: Permanent

Empower finance leadership through strategic transformation

The Role

Capco is looking for Principal Consultants to join our growing Finance Transformation capability within the Finance, Risk, Regulatory & Financial Crime (FRRF) practice. You'll play a key role in helping CFOs, Treasurers, and senior finance leaders maximise the value of their finance and treasury functions through operating model redesign, process transformation, and strategic technology delivery. You'll also leverage approved AI tools and AI-enabled ways of working to improve analysis, accelerate insight generation, and enhance delivery while applying responsible AI practices and appropriate human oversight.

What You'll Do

• Define business requirements and manage end-to-end project delivery across finance, treasury, and regulatory change initiatives, ensuring appropriate governance where AI-assisted tools are utilised.

• Collaborate with technology teams to embed digital, automation, and AI-enabled solutions into finance processes, architecture, and operating models to improve efficiency and business outcomes.

What We're Looking For

• Experience delivering finance transformation programmes within financial services or management consulting.

• Strong understanding of finance operating models, accounting processes, regulatory change, and financial reporting.

• Experience with finance technology implementations, including ERP platforms, subledgers, automation, and optimisation solutions.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using approved AI tools to enhance analysis, productivity, and decision-making while maintaining sound professional judgement.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence audiences from project teams through to CFOs and executive leadership.

Bonus Points For

• Professional finance qualification such as ACA, ACCA, or CIMA.

• Familiarity with Basel, Solvency II, IFRS, SOX, PRA, or EBA regulatory requirements.

• Experience delivering finance transformation programmes involving RPA, cloud technologies, AI-enabled solutions, or Generative AI within finance functions.

• Strong business analysis or project management credentials such as Agile, PMI, or PRINCE2.

• Experience supporting business development, proposition development, leadership initiatives, or client growth.

Why Join Capco

• Deliver high-impact transformation programmes for Tier 1 financial institutions.

• Work in a collaborative, flat, and entrepreneurial consulting culture.

• Access continuous learning, industry certifications, and structured career development.

• Help shape the future of finance transformation through innovation, automation, and technology.

• Be part of a team delivering meaningful change across financial services and energy.

Benefits

• Core Benefits: Discretionary bonus, competitive pension, health insurance, life insurance and critical illness cover.

• Mental Health: Easy access to CareFirst, Unmind, Aviva consultations, and in-house first aiders.

title: CRO Specialist
description:

Location:

This role is focused on improving user experience, conversion rates, and engagement across our own platforms. My Amazon Guy is a thriving digital marketing agency with over 500+ employees and a diverse range of clients. Our culture is dynamic, rewarding, and innovative. We are dedicated to helping our clients achieve remarkable sales growth while ensuring their peace of mind.

title: ESG & Environmental and Social Management Consultant (C-26-14)
description:
This is a remote position.
The International Potato Center (CIP) is strengthening its institutional approach to Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) and Environmental and Social Management (ESM), appropriate to its mandate as an international agricultural research organization, its decentralized operating model, and the environmental and social risks associated with its research, operations, projects, partnerships and field activities.
Benchmarking with other CGIAR Centers and the CGIAR System Organization indicates ESG should not be treated solely as a sustainability reporting exercise: a credible approach also requires mechanisms to identify, assess, manage, monitor and evidence environmental and social risks across the organization and project lifecycle.CIP's approach therefore spans two complementary dimensions:

• Institutional ESG and sustainability - CIP's own environmental, social and governance responsibilities and performance; and

• Project-level environmental and social safeguards - risks and impacts associated with research, projects, field activities, partners, suppliers and communities.

CIP intends to build on its existing governance, enterprise risk management, project management, partner management and internal control arrangements, rather than establish a separate ESG structure. At the same time, CIP wishes to: become ready to demonstrate alignment with ISO 14001; establish a credible and proportionate ESG framework; strengthen safeguards to meet Green Climate Fund (GCF) and comparable climate-finance requirements; understand GCF requirements beyond ISO 14001; understand how far existing fiduciary and institutional systems already support GCF readiness; and build a baseline that responds efficiently to other donors
Objective:
The purpose of the consultancy is to establish where CIP is today; what target ESG and Environmental & Social Management architecture is appropriate for CIP; what gaps exist against ISO, GCF and relevant donor expectations; and what practical, proportionate steps CIP should take to close them.
The assignment is structured as three sequential phases. Phase 1 is scoped as a self-contained diagnostic and policy engagement that CIP can commission and complete on its own. Phases 2 and 3 build on Phase 1's findings and are intended to be scoped in detail - and commissioned - once Phase 1 is complete, so that their design reflects what the baseline and gap analysis actually show, rather than being fixed in advance.
This consultancy advertisement is for Phase 1 only. Phases 2 and 3 are indicative future phases and will be scoped and commissioned separately based on the findings of Phase 1.
The consultant should havedemonstrated experience assessing and designing ESG and environmental and social management frameworks in international or decentralized organizations. The ideal candidate will combine technical expertise in ISO 14001, environmental and social safeguards and climate-finance requirements with the ability to translate international standards into practical and proportionate institutional arrangements.
Deliverables:
Phase 1 - Diagnose and Frame (4-6 weeks)
Establish where CIP stands today against ISO 14001, institutional ESG maturity, GCF environmental and social safeguards readiness, and broader donor requirements. Deliver a validated current-state and maturity assessment, an integrated gap analysis, a draft CIP ESG/Environmental and Social Management Policy, and a management briefing with recommendations on Phase 2/3 scope and sequencing. Phase 1 is a self-contained engagement that CIP can act independently. See Annex A for the full topic taxonomy: environmental, social and governance sub-areas).
Phase 1 Deliverables

• D1.1 - Inception Report and Requirements Crosswalk

• D1.2 - CIP Current-State and Maturity Assessment

• D1.3 - Integrated Gap Analysis (ISO / ESG / GCF safeguards / broader GCF institutional map / other donors)

• D1.4 - Draft CIP ESG / Environmental & Social M

description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles:  We Before Me , Do the Right Thing , and Get Things Done . These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Team

The Compliance function at OKX is responsible for promoting a strong compliance culture and supporting the business in meeting its regulatory obligations and managing enterprise risk.

The Product Compliance team is responsible for embedding compliance into the product lifecycle and supporting the compliant development, launch and ongoing operation of OKX products and features globally across all markets in which our products and services are offered. We work closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, Central Compliance and local Compliance teams to identify regulatory and compliance requirements, assess product risks and develop practical solutions that support responsible commercial growth.

About the Opportunity

 We are seeking an experienced, hands-on and commercially minded Senior Compliance Manager to join our Product Compliance team.
This is a senior individual-contributor role focused primarily on the day-to-day review of new products, material product changes and existing product enhancements. The emphasis is on delivering timely, well-reasoned product compliance assessments using a risk-based approach, ensuring that material compliance risks are sufficiently mitigated and the firm’s regulatory positioning protected.

You will act as a trusted compliance partner throughout the product development lifecycle, helping Product and Engineering teams navigate complex regulatory requirements while enabling commercially viable outcomes. You will be expected to distinguish between legal or regulatory constraints that cannot be crossed, risks that can be addressed through proportionate controls, and residual risks that require documented escalation or risk acceptance.

 

What You’ll Be Doing

•

• Own and deliver day-to-day compliance reviews of new products, features, market expansions and material changes to existing products across OKX's global business and product suite.

• Review product requirements, technical documentation, user journeys, onboarding flows, trading or transaction mechanics, reward structures, disclosures and operational processes.

• Apply a risk-based waterfall that distinguishes hard legal or regulatory blockers from risks that may be addressed through controls, product conditions, jurisdictional restrictions, monitoring or escalation.

• Conduct and document product compliance risk assessments covering areas such as regulatory perimeter and licensing, AML/CFT, sanctions, KYC, consumer protection, financial promotions, trading and market conduct, asset safeguarding, data privacy and third-party risk.

• Produce clear, concise and evidence-based and solutions-based compliance recommendations setting out identified risks, required mitigants, residual exposure and the proposed approval or escalation route.

• Work directly with Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, Central Compliance and local Compliance teams to develop practical and scalable solutions to identified compliance requirements.

• Maintain complete and accurate documentation and audit trails for product reviews, decisions, conditions, exceptions, approvals

Advantmed is a healthcare services company headquartered in Irvine, California, serving primarily health plans that participate in government-sponsored programs. The Company operates three lines of business: medical record retrieval; medical record review and coding; and in-home health assessments. Together these support health plans across risk adjustment, HEDIS, quality reporting, and member care - with a substantial delivery organization in Ahmedabad, India supporting the U.S. operation.

Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Travel: Firmware engineering requires hands-on collaboration with Hardware Engineering. Direct Reports: None

title: AI Data Lead
description:
Data-AI Lead
About Us
OurRitual is a fast-growing digital platform reshaping how relationship therapy works. We combine expert-led therapy sessions with AI-powered support to create a blended experience - where clinical depth and intelligent technology weave together into something neither could deliver alone. We call it Continuous Therapy. We've reached product-market fit with strong growth, exceptional engagement, and retention that breaks the category. We're pre-Series A, at the stage where AI moves from feature to foundation - and that shift runs straight through data.
Role Overview
As Data Lead, you will own how data gets turned into decisions across the company - and lead the shift from traditional BI into AI-driven BI, powered by agents that surface insight in real time. You'll work closely with one data engineer today, with room to grow the team as scope expands.
You'll define what the data function looks like when AI is embedded in it, not bolted on - from the underlying infrastructure to the dashboards and agents people actually use. The playbook for AI-native BI is still being written, and you'll write a lot of it.
Key Responsibilities
Data Strategy & Ownership

• Own the vision and roadmap for the data function, including the shift from classic BI to agent-based, AI-driven BI

• Set priorities in partnership with senior leadership

• Work closely with a data engineer today, with the option to grow the team as the function scales

AI-Driven BI & Agents

• Drive adoption of AI across data workflows - from automating analyses to agents answering business questions in real time

• Own the semantic and metrics layer so every dashboard and every agent reads the same definitions

• Build in a git-based workflow: dashboards and queries live in git, edited through PRs, built with agents

• Expose our data to agents over MCP so business questions get answered without waiting for a dashboard

• Define where AI speeds things up - and where human judgment still has to hold the line

Infrastructure & Analytics

• Own the data infrastructure: BigQuery, dbt, pipelines, and data reliability

• Lead complex analytics work, A/B testing, and impact measurement, hands-on

• Define evals and quality metrics for AI features and agents - not just A/B tests on dashboards

Cross-functional Collaboration

• Partner with product, marketing, finance, operations, and engineering to define analytical needs and turn them into solutions

• Represent the data function to the organization - senior-level storytelling with data

Skills & Qualifications

• 7+ years of experience in data roles, spanning both analytics and infrastructure

• Strong analytical foundation - you understand what makes analysis rigorous, not just what makes it automatable, and can use that to build an AI-driven analytics system that's actually trustworthy

• Hands-on experience integrating AI into data workflows - building it, not just using it; you've shipped an agent or AI analysis flow that people actually use

• Strong SQL skills and experience building scalable data infrastructure

• Track record owning data projects independently with stakeholders across the business

• Solid grounding in experimentation and statistical methods

• Excellent communication and presentation skills at a leadership level

• Comfortable being the most senior (and often only) data voice in the room

Nice-to-Have Skills

• Experience with dbt

• Experience with Amplitude

• Experience with BigQuery

• Experience with git-based BI workflows or tools like Modus

• B2C environment experience

Why This Role
Data teams are about to look very different - not because dashboards disappear, but because people expect answers faster than a weekly report can deliver. This is a rare opportunity to define what AI-native data leadership looks like at a company sitting on a dataset that doesn't exist anywhere else, with real ownership over how the function grows. title: Account Executive, Post-Acute Care
description:
About Aidin

Hi, we're Aidin ! We're here to create solutions for healthcare’s biggest challenges. Instead of waiting for someone else to step up, we rolled up our sleeves and created a better way to connect patients, payers, and care providers.
We are on a mission to defragment the healthcare ecosystem with a seamless digital platform that transforms healthcare for good and improves outcomes for all.
What We Do
Aidin is a dynamic healthcare technology company dedicated to revolutionizing care coordination and post-acute care transitions. Our innovative platform empowers healthcare organizations to streamline workflows, reduce costs, and ensure patients receive the highest quality post-acute care. You can learn more about us at www.my Aidin .com.
About The Opportunity
Aidin is looking for a growth-focused Account Executive, Post-Acute Care to manage a portfolio of existing post-acute care (PAC) clients while driving net-new business in smaller accounts. This is a revenue-carrying role focused on expansion and growth - you'll upsell current clients, land new logos, and consistently hit or exceed quota.
This role is ideal for someone who thrives in both relationship management and consultative selling - comfortable farming accounts but also motivated to hunt new opportunities. Our distributed team works 100% remotely on U.S. Eastern or Central time.
What You Will Do

• Prospect and close net-new business with regional PAC providers (SNFs, home health, hospice, IRF, referral partners)

• Run full sales cycles: discovery, demo, proposal, negotiation, and close

• Drive annual expansion within your existing account base through upsells and additional facility growth

• Use Aidin 's performance data and market reports to lead consultative, insight-driven conversations

• Deliver tailored demos that speak directly to PAC workflows, intake challenges, and executive priorities

• Articulate ROI - referral growth, census impact, competitive positioning - in terms healthcare decision-makers care about

• Own the onboarding experience for newly signed accounts and serve as the primary point of contact during the critical first 90 days

• Train users and administrators on Aidin 's reporting tools and how to act on data to drive referral improvement

• Manage an ongoing portfolio of regional accounts - monitor health, address issues proactively, and build lasting relationships

• Own the full renewal cycle: start conversations early, reinforce value, and close on time

• Maintain accurate pipeline, account records, and forecasts in HubSpot

• Feed market and client insights back to leadership to inform product and strategy

Skills & Qualifications

• 2-4 years of experience in account management or sales in healthcare SaaS within post-acute care, hospital/health system, senior care, home health

• Proven track record of hitting or exceeding quota through upsells and new logo acquisition

• Strong negotiation and presentation skills with the ability to engage executives

• Experience running both renewal/expansion cycles and net-new business sales cycles

• CRM experience required (HubSpot preferred); proven ability to run product demos and close business independently

• Strong organization and follow-through - you can manage a portfolio without dropping the ball

• Must be a self starter and “comfortable with the uncomfortable”; experience with another early-stage startup a major bonus

• Coachability is critical to the success

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

Culture and Values
At Aidin , our team is guided by four core values that shape everything we do:

• Lead, Do Not React: Think big-picture, long-term, and do the right thing. We want team members who take initiative and lead with vision, rather than simply reacting to circumstances

• Make a Difference: For us, outcomes are everything. Be the solution. We value making a tangible impact through every event and initiative

title: Manager, Trade Promotion Management
description:
Confido is the AI infrastructure powering modern CPG - the platform that 200+ brands like OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Dr. Squatch, and Tropicana use to run everything from deductions to production planning. Finance, accounting, sales, and operations, unified in one system for the first time.

We're growing 5x year over year with a small team in New York City; the people who join now will shape the product, the culture, and the company itself.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere - and outsized ownership while you build - we'd love to meet you.

THE ROLE

We're hiring a TPM Manager to own the sales forecasting, trade planning, and trade optimization experience for our customers. TPM sit at the center of what Confido automates for CPG brands, and this role is the connective tissue between our Sales, Implementation, Customer Success, and Product teams - making sure customers actually resolve trade faster and more accurately on our platform, not just process them.

You'll work hands-on with customer sales forecasting and trade plans to help new customers get their TPM workflows configured correctly during onboarding, and be the expert voice that tells Product where the platform's TPM logic needs to evolve.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Product & Engineering

- Own the trade promotion management roadmap in partnership with Product and Engineering, prioritizing based on what brands actually need to plan, execute, and reconcile trade spend

- Translate trade planning processes - sales forecasting, promotion planning, promotion optimization, financial reconciliation, and ROI reporting - into clear, buildable product requirements

- Synthesize customer feedback, identify trends, and competitive intelligence into a prioritized set of product bets

Customer Success

- Lead discovery and design sessions with customer trade, sales, and finance teams to map how they plan and execute trade spend today, and how it should work on Confido

- Guide customers through TPM implementation - configuring promotion calendars, accrual rules, and deduction-matching logic - and train teams on how to run their trade spend operations in Confido

- Build the playbooks, SOPs, and internal training that let Sales, Implementation, and Customer Success teams operate without you in the room - your expertise should scale, not bottleneck

Go-to-Market

- Be Confido's voice on trade promotion management with customers, prospects, partners, and at industry events

- Partner with Sales and Marketing on discovery calls, deal support, and content that speaks credibly to trade, finance, and sales-ops audiences

- Track how brands, retailers, and distributors are evolving their trade spend practices, and turn those shifts into competitive positioning and battlecards for the broader team

- Build direct relationships with the retailers, brokers, and industry bodies that shape how trade programs get structured and reported

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

5+ years of hands-on trade planning experience at CPG brands, including direct responsibility for planning baselines and trade, executing plans, and reconciling trade yourself - extra points if you have implemented TPM systems

Fluency in the trade mechanics such as baseline planning, trade promotion types, rate base vs lump sum planning, accruals, off-invoice vs. bill-back, and how trade spend rolls up to gross-to-net revenue

A track record of turning operational expertise into product requirements, and comfort working directly with Engineering

Strong customer-facing instincts - you can run a discovery session, defend a design decision, and de-escalate an angry VP of Trade in the same week

Experience representing a product or point of view externally (webinars, conferences, analyst conversations)

 
 

🌴 PERKS + BENEFITS

- Equity - own a meaningful piece of the company you’re helping build

- Fully paid health coverage through Aetna - we cover 100% of employee premiums

- Top-tier dental and vision coverage through Guardian

title: Wireless Regulatory Engineer - SAR
description:
WIRELESS REGULATORY ENGINEER - SAR

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Consumer Devices team at OpenAI builds products that bring advanced AI capabilities into thoughtfully designed consumer experiences. We work across hardware, software, design, and research to develop reliable products from early exploration through production.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Wireless Regulatory Engineer to support RF exposure compliance for consumer hardware. You’ll work closely with RF, antenna, hardware, software, and regulatory teams throughout the product development lifecycle, helping ensure products meet applicable requirements while maintaining a high bar for performance and user experience.

This role is based in Mountain View, CA. We use a hybrid work model of four days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Develop and execute RF exposure test and validation strategies for consumer wireless products.

- Partner with engineering teams to evaluate product designs and identify potential compliance risks throughout development.

- Perform and analyze RF exposure measurements and communicate findings clearly to cross-functional teams.

- Support product development from early prototypes through validation, certification, and production.

- Coordinate testing with external laboratories and review results and supporting documentation.

- Translate applicable regulatory requirements into practical engineering guidance.

- Partner with RF and antenna teams to balance regulatory requirements with product performance.

- Develop tools and workflows that improve testing efficiency, consistency, and data analysis.

- Investigate issues, identify root causes, and work with engineering teams to develop effective solutions.

- Support global regulatory certification activities for wireless consumer products.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

- Have a Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, RF Engineering, or a related technical field.

- Bring deep experience with SAR, RF exposure, or wireless regulatory testing.

- Have a strong understanding of RF fundamentals, measurement techniques, and wireless systems.

- Have experience translating regulatory requirements into engineering and product decisions.

- Are comfortable performing hands-on testing, analyzing complex measurement data, and troubleshooting hardware systems.

- Have experience working with external test laboratories and supporting product certification.

- Collaborate effectively across RF, antenna, hardware, software, manufacturing, and operations teams.

- Are comfortable working in fast-moving, ambiguous product development environments.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team and work remotely from the comfort of their home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

• Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.

• Typically, clinicians work between Mondays - Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM - 7:00 PM.
